f3_program: transfer("purchase", "daphney", "supermarket.potatoes", "daphney.potatoes", at("daphney.potatoes.purchase.mass", "current"), source("Daphney buys 5 kg of potatoes at the supermarket"))

rate_relation(at("daphney.potatoes.purchase.cost", "current"), "supermarket.potatoes.price_per_kilogram", at("daphney.potatoes.purchase.mass", "current"), source("Daphney buys 5 kg of potatoes at the supermarket. If 2 kg of potatoes costs $6"))
assumptions: The conditional supermarket price applies to Daphney's 5 kg purchase at the same per-kilogram rate.
The stated ratio order makes Swedish Krona the numerator and Taiwan Dollar the denominator.

f3_program: partition("yarn.parts", at("yarn.length", "initial"), source("cut into 5 equal parts"))

consume("crocheting_use", "crocheting", at("yarn.length", "current"), fraction(at("yarn.length", "initial"), 3, 5), source("A 10 meters yarn was cut into 5 equal parts. If 3 parts were used for crocheting"))

assumptions: The source does not state the liter-to-milliliter conversion needed to compare the container and portion quantities, and F3-v1 does not permit inventing that conversion.

f3_program: observe(at("company.average_price_paid_per_share", "January 26, 2019 - February 22, 2019"), 64.77, "currency_per_share", cell("January 26, 2019 - February 22, 2019", "Average Price Paid per Share"))
observe(at("company.average_price_paid_per_share", "February 23, 2019 - March 22, 2019"), 65.53, "currency_per_share", cell("February 23, 2019 - March 22, 2019", "Average Price Paid per Share"))
assumptions: The first and second month periods are the first two dated rows in the table.
